products.product_description: Delish Greek Style Orzo Salad; Traditional orzo, cucumber, red bell peppers, green onion and Kalamata olives tossed with a creamy Greek Style yogurt and feta dressing. 6 oz (170g) in clam shell plastic container. Packaged for Walgreens Manufactured by Glass Onion Catering, Richmond, CA.
products.reason_for_recall: Investigation into an outbreak of e-coli 0157:H7 found that Glass Onion Catering was the supplier of the products. All FDA regulated products were made with similar ingredients.
